items.title: U.S. October PCE inf seen rising to 3.8%, lifting December Fed hike bets
items.summary: U.S. consumers are expected to maintain strong spending ahead of the holiday shopping season, with inflation pressure yet to curb outlays. Economists surveyed by Bloomberg see inflation-adjusted PCE rising 0.1% MoM in October, after strong gains in each of the prior two quarters. The PCE price index is forecast to rise 3.8% YoY, while core PCE is also expected to accelerate, bolstering expectations for a December Fed rate hike. Continued job growth and resilient consumer and business activity give policymakers room to focus on inflation, even as rising prices add to pressure on the Fed.

items.title: France sees sixth straight Saturday of protests
items.summary: Protesters took to the streets in Paris and elsewhere on Saturday, the sixth consecutive weekend of demonstrations since protests on Oct. 17 escalated into serious unrest. Turnout was the lowest yet. The Interior Ministry said 82,500 people demonstrated nationwide, while unions organizing the marches put attendance at 150,000. Participants included unions, student groups and Yellow Vest activists. The government deployed 70,000 police and gendarmes.

items.title: Tesla launches FSD v15 in the U.S.
items.summary: Tesla said it has begun rolling out the first version of FSD v15 to Early Access Program members in the U.S., claiming a 25-fold improvement in handling safety-critical scenarios. The update adds Tesla Reality View, which overlays camera feeds with FSD driving plans, and improves driving over potholes and debris as well as speed control near schools and in bad weather. items.summary: 【SpaceX龙飞船完成第35次商业补给任务】金十数据11月22日讯，SpaceX(SPCX.O)的龙飞船于周六从国际空间站返回地球，在洛杉矶海岸附近成功溅落，完成了该公司对国际空间站的第35次商业补给服务任务。SpaceX于当天下午2点04分在社交平台X上确认了这一消息。龙飞船是停靠在空间站的四艘飞船之一。NASA官员表示，该飞船带回了数千磅货物，其中包括多项具有科研价值的研究样本：一个用于研究太空和地球血管衰老与心血管疾病的3D生物打印血管构造；在空间站上处理过的冷冻肿瘤类器官，可能有助于改善癌症治疗和推进个性化医疗；以及一套在空间站运行三年多、用于测试宇航员长期任务睡眠与健康支持效果的照明系统。

items.title: Libya Hamada pipeline shutdown for more than 20 days causes over $30 mln in losses
items.summary: Libya’s National Oil Corp. said an armed group has forcibly shut the Hamada pipeline for more than 20 days, cutting output and causing significant economic losses. Production has fallen by an average 14,418 bpd since the shutdown, resulting in estimated revenue losses of about $1.4706 mln a day, while affected fields continue to incur fixed operating costs. The affected fields are Hamada (NC5 and NC8) and Tihara (NC4), operated by Arabian Gulf Oil Co. Cumulative lost output has reached 302,778 barrels, with revenue losses estimated at about $30.7925 mln at current average oil prices.
